caption: The drawing shows a textile or tapestry with an intricate, geometric floral pattern. The primary colors used are red, blue, green, and gold. The design consists of horizontal stripes, each with different motifs: stylized leaves, flowers, and symmetrical shapes in gold against backgrounds of varying colors—primarily red, blue, and green. Near the bottom right, there is a rectangular blue section with gold text reading "EMANUEL GRUBE WARWICK." Below it, on a red background, gold letters spell out "TL&CP 1840," with a small green rectangle at the very bottom containing the gold text "M.T. GOOD." The edges of the textile are fringed with threads in red, blue, and green. In the top right corner, another rectangular section shows a continuation of the floral motif with the same color scheme. The overall composition is organized with repeating horizontal bands and a border along the bottom.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
